name: Lala Lucia-Saint
source:
The first child and heir of the royal family Lucia. A very mercenary girl and always looks for her own benefit. Collaborates with the Blaude Witzch to regain power.
Participant of the Liberty-Redable project. According to the Longevity system, Lala is a top-ranking mtsyr.
